capabilities: Render clipbook code blocks as copyable entry lists
Mask and reveal secret values with auto re-masking
Edit entries inline and write changes back to the Markdown source
Quick-add entries to new or existing sections
Fuzzy-find and copy any entry from the command palette
disambiguation: Masking hides values visually only; it is not encryption, and plaintext stays in the Markdown source.
extras: README warns that values are stored as plain text, multiline values (SSH keys, certificates) are unsupported, and editing/indexing is unavailable for blocks nested in callouts or list items.
problem: Obsidian notes have no built-in way to keep API keys, tokens, and reusable snippets organized, masked, and quickly copyable.
summary: Code-block-based snippet store that renders clipbook blocks as copyable lists with masked secrets, inline editing, and a vault-wide copy command.
